title: Infrastructure Hardening v3 — close the four .86-retro bottlenecks
notes: Three of the four code changes were wired into research_conductor.py and verify_repair.py before this experiment ran (per the .86 retro emergency patch). exp1117 additionally fixed a load-bearing YAML structural bug in ops/exclusion_manifest.yaml: orphan top-level list entries (exp906/exp786/exp641 + 3 scope retirements) made the file unparseable, so failure_ledger_v2.is_excluded_by_manifest had been silently fail-opening since .80 — the dispatch-time enforcement only became truly live in .87 with this fix. exp1117 also adds the regression-tripwire test suite + this artifact, which .87 onward will read to confirm the fixes survive future edits.
